title: 12 January 1963: Live: Invicta Ballroom, Chatham
content:
The Beatles travelled 170 miles for a performance at the Invicta Ballroom in Chatham, Kent.

It was the only time the group performed at the venue. The Beatles had not played many shows in the south of England at the time, but that was soon to change.
